name: BERBERIS AQUIFOLIUM
key_symptoms: Tongue thickly coated, yellowish-brown; feels blistered. Burning in stomach. Nausea and hunger after eating.
Urine.--Stitching, crampy pains; thick mucus, and bright-red, mealy sediment.
Sensation of a band just above ears. Bilious headache. "Scald head". Scaly eczema.

skin_symptoms: Pimply, dry, rough, scaly. Eruption on scalp extending to face and neck. Tumor of breast, with pain. Psoriasis. Acne. Dry eczema. Pruritus. Glandular induration.
